chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Yahya al-Attar (mercy of God be upon him) narrated to me, he said: Sa'd ibn Abd Allah narrated to me, on the authority of Ahmad ibn Abu Abd Allah, on the authority of Ya'qub ibn Yazid, on the authority of Muhammad ibn Abu Umayr, on the authority of one he mentioned, from Abu Abd Allah (peace be upon him)

He said: Iblis said to Isa ibn Maryam (peace be upon him): 'Does your Lord have the power to place the Earth inside an egg, without making the Earth smaller or the egg any bigger?' Thus, Isa (peace be upon him) replied: 'Woe unto you! Verily, Allah cannot be described with limits. Who has more power than He who diminishes the Earth, and enlarges the egg?'

key_terms.عِيسَى ابْنِ مَرْيَمَ: Isa ibn Maryam (Jesus, son of Mary)

ai.seo_question: What is the dialogue between Iblis and Prophet Isa regarding Allah's omnipotence?
ai.summary: This narration from Shaykh al-Saduq’s *al-Tawhid* illustrates the concept of *Qudra* (divine power) through the dialogue between Iblis and Prophet Isa (AS), highlighting that Allah’s ability is not constrained by physical laws or human logic. While Iblis questions the possibility of simultaneous size alteration, Isa affirms that God can diminish the Earth and enlarge the egg, demonstrating that divine omnipotence transcends natural limitations without requiring a change in essence. This hadith serves as a key theological proof in Shia scholarship for the absolute and unconstrained nature of God’s power.

en.sayed-ali-raza-rizvi: 5. Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Yahya al-`Attar (RA) said: Sa`d ibn `Abd Allah related to me, on the authority of Ahmad ibn Abu `Abd Allah, on the authority of Ya`qub ibn Yazid, on the authority of Muhammad ibn Abu `Umayr, on the authority of one he mentioned, that Abu `Abd Allah (AS) said:

Iblis said to `Isa the son of Maryam (AS): “Does Your Lord have the omnipotence to place Earth inside an egg, without making the Earth smaller or the egg any bigger?” Thus, `Isa (AS) replied, “Woe unto you! Verily, Allah cannot be described with limits. Who has more power than He who diminishes the Earth, and enlarges the egg?”
